purpose: Held-out npm/Node codec acquisition test on a different binary format, with no package-name or binding hint.
goal: Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/NPM_CBOR_SOURCE.json containing exactly four records with fields id and text: 1 alpha, 2 beta, 3 gamma, 4 delta. Using a zero-cost npm JavaScript library executed by Node.js, encode those exact records as CBOR and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/NPM_CBOR_RECORDS.cbor. Independently decode the CBOR artifact in a fresh Node.js process and verify the decoded records are exactly identical to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/NPM_CBOR_SOURCE.json in values, order, field names, and record count.
